summary.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ: Legendreの3項漸化式からGauss節点と重みを構成し、2n−1次までの多項式モーメントと指数関数を検査します。適応Simpsonは指数関数とLorentz型ピークを積分し、解析積分・独立QUADPACKと比較します。 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点: Gauss次数と適応公差を走査し、狭いLorentzピーク、平方根端点、巨大な相殺、零積分、見逃すcompact bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。
summary.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK. Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK.

limitations.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ: Simpsonの局所推定は任意の関数に対する厳密な誤差上界ではありません。高周波の見落とし、特異点、丸め誤差の停滞を一般に解決する実装ではなく、Gauss–KronrodやQUADPACK全体の再実装でもありません。 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点: Simpsonの推定値は厳密誤差上界ではありません。盲点の検出に合格しても積分精度への合格ではありません。平方根の直接積分は深さ予算で未収束と表示し得ます。任意の振動・特異性の完全な探索や認証付き求積は主張しません。
limitations.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets: The local Simpson estimate is not a rigorous error bound for arbitrary functions. The implementation does not generally solve missed high frequencies, singularities or roundoff stagnation, and it is not a reimplementation of Gauss–Kronrod or all of QUADPACK. Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots: The Simpson estimate is not a certified error bound. Passing the blind-spot control does not mean accurate integration. Direct square-root integration may honestly terminate at its depth budget. Exhaustive oscillatory/singular exploration and certified quadrature are not claimed.

title.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ
title.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets

summary.ja: Legendreの3項漸化式からGauss節点と重みを構成し、2n−1次までの多項式モーメントと指数関数を検査します。適応Simpsonは指数関数とLorentz型ピークを積分し、解析積分・独立QUADPACKと比較します。
summary.en: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK.

assumptions.ja: 有限区間上の滑らかな実関数、無次元の積分です。固定Gauss次数2・4・8・16と、適応絶対公差10⁻⁵・10⁻⁷・10⁻⁹を別々に走査します。両端特異点・不連続・無限区間は今回の入力では扱いません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless smooth real functions on finite intervals. Fixed Gauss orders 2/4/8/16 and adaptive absolute tolerances 10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹ are swept separately. Endpoint singularities, discontinuities and infinite intervals are not covered by these inputs.

algorithm.ja: Golub–Welschで対称Jacobi行列の固有値を節点、最初の固有ベクトル成分の平方の2倍を重みとします。適応Simpsonは区間を二分し、|S左+S右−S全|/15を局所推定として公差を配分します。評価回数と深さの上限を持ち、未達を成功としません。
algorithm.en: Golub–Welsch obtains nodes from a symmetric Jacobi matrix and weights from twice the squared first eigenvector components. Adaptive Simpson bisects intervals and allocates tolerances using |Sleft+Sright−Swhole|/15 as a local estimate. Evaluation and depth limits report unmet targets explicitly.

validation.ja: 全指定次数の多項式モーメント、SciPy roots_legendreの節点・重みとの差、解析exp積分の次数収束、解析atan積分とSciPy quadへの一致を測ります。公差を厳しくしたときの評価数と誤差を示し、5評価の強制予算切れ、非有限関数値も検査します。
validation.en: Measure polynomial moments for every chosen order, node/weight differences from SciPy roots_legendre, order refinement for the analytic exponential integral, and agreement with analytic arctangent and SciPy quad references. Store evaluation counts/errors as tolerance tightens; test forced exhaustion after five evaluations and nonfinite integrands.

limits.ja: Simpsonの局所推定は任意の関数に対する厳密な誤差上界ではありません。高周波の見落とし、特異点、丸め誤差の停滞を一般に解決する実装ではなく、Gauss–KronrodやQUADPACK全体の再実装でもありません。
limits.en: The local Simpson estimate is not a rigorous error bound for arbitrary functions. The implementation does not generally solve missed high frequencies, singularities or roundoff stagnation, and it is not a reimplementation of Gauss–Kronrod or all of QUADPACK.

title.ja: 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点
title.en: Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots

summary.ja: Gauss次数と適応公差を走査し、狭いLorentzピーク、平方根端点、巨大な相殺、零積分、見逃すcompact bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。
summary.en: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK.

assumptions.ja: 区間[0,1]、Gauss次数8/16/32/64/128、公差10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹です。Lorentz幅.1/.03/.01、相殺係数0/2¹²/2²⁴/2³⁶を固定します。零積分の相対条件数は未定義としてnullで保存します。
assumptions.en: Use[0,1], Gauss orders8/16/32/64/128 and tolerances10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹. Lorentz widths are.1/.03/.01; cancellation scales are0/2¹²/2²⁴/2³⁶. A zero integral has undefined relative condition, stored as null.

algorithm.ja: Golub–Welschの節点・重みと、局所差/15を用いる適応Simpsonを実装します。端点ではx=t²変換を別対照とし、狭いbumpには既知支持区間を分割した対照を用意します。これは一般的な自動救済機構ではありません。
algorithm.en: Implement Golub–Welsch nodes/weights and adaptive Simpson with a local difference/15 estimate. Companion checks use x=t² for the endpoint and a known-support split for the narrow bump; these are not general automatic rescue mechanisms.

validation.ja: roots_legendre、解析atan積分、2/3、bumpの256w/315、独立QUADPACKを比較します。QUADPACKの状態・推定誤差・評価回数・警告文も保存します。相殺はε_machine×積分絶対量に対応する絶対予算を使います。初期5点が全て零のbumpでは推定誤差0と実誤差約.00813を明示します。
validation.en: Compare roots_legendre, analytic atan integrals,2/3,the bump integral256w/315 and independent QUADPACK. Preserve QUADPACK status, estimated error, evaluation count and warning message. Cancellation uses a roundoff-aware absolute budget. When all initial five bump samples vanish, expose estimated error0 versus actual error about.00813.

limits.ja: Simpsonの推定値は厳密誤差上界ではありません。盲点の検出に合格しても積分精度への合格ではありません。平方根の直接積分は深さ予算で未収束と表示し得ます。任意の振動・特異性の完全な探索や認証付き求積は主張しません。
limits.en: The Simpson estimate is not a certified error bound. Passing the blind-spot control does not mean accurate integration. Direct square-root integration may honestly terminate at its depth budget. Exhaustive oscillatory/singular exploration and certified quadrature are not claimed.

review.ja: 二つの近似積分値の差が偶然小さい場合の誤差推定失敗を原文の選択節で確認しました。今回のSimpson対照は教材独自の構成であり、同論文の新積分器を実装したとは呼びません。
review.en: Checked selected original discussion of accidentally small differences between quadrature estimates. The educational Simpson counterexample is original test design, not an implementation of the paper’s new integrators.
